coder_notes: Glioblastoma is named only in outcome descriptions (RANO response in 'glioblastoma participants'); inclusion says 'solid tumor including primary brain tumor' and Cohort 5 label mentions 'primary brain tumors', neither naming glioblastoma, so not_glioblastoma under C7 with uncertain flag. PF-07284890 is given alone in Part A monotherapy and with binimetinib in all other arms; coded experimental_monotherapy treating binimetinib (approved, fixed 45 mg BID) as a backbone partner; if binimetinib is considered investigational, both would be experimental_combination. Midazolam is a DDI probe substrate (no therapeutic role), coded diagnostic_agent as the closest role. BRAF V600 mutation is a trial-wide entry requirement matched to the BRAF inhibitor. Mixed age (16+).
